correctness.rationale: PASS: For n>=5 and Delta(H)<=2 every nonedge of complement G has a common G-neighbor, hence diam(G)<=2. A G-general-position set induces a disjoint union of cliques, equivalently H[S] complete multipartite; under max degree 2 its nonindependent possibilities are precisely K2,P3,K3,C4. Counting these gives ψ(G;z)=I(H;z)+e(H)z²+(p+t)z³+qz⁴. Independence polynomials of paths/cycles have negative real zeros and strict Newton ratio bounds. The displayed n>=14 union-bound inequalities control the four disturbed coefficients; independent integer program exhaustively regenerated all unordered path/cycle component multisets of n=5..13, obtaining counts 11,19,29,46,70,106,156,232,334 and minimum log-concavity slack 15,21,28,36,45,55,66,78,91, all positive. Finite enumeration covers only n<=13, with separate symbolic bounds for n>=14; selected unbounded stress cases are not treated as proof.
